translations.web: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
translations.bsb: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.
translations.kjv: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
translations.asv: In measure, when thou sendest them away, thou dost content with them; he hath removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
